tasks.intent: identify type of information requested, not answer WHY

en.instruction: Read this question. What information does the speaker want to find out? Explain in your own words without answering the question itself.

teacherOnly.illustrativeFunctionalParaphrase: They want to know the reason someone prefers the fresh cheese.
teacherOnly.nonLiteralReasonVariant: Because its mild flavor goes well with the salmon.
teacherOnly.commonConfusion: Describing the cheese instead of explaining what the question asks.

es.instruction: Lee esta pregunta. ¿Qué información quiere conocer la persona que pregunta? Explícalo con tus palabras sin contestar la pregunta en sí.

teacherOnly.illustrativeFunctionalParaphrase: Quiere saber el motivo por el cual alguien prefiere el queso fresco.
teacherOnly.meaningAnchor: causa de la preferencia por el queso
teacherOnly.nonLiteralReasonVariant: Porque su sabor suave va bien con el salmón.
teacherOnly.commonConfusion: Describir el queso sin identificar qué información solicita la pregunta.

pt.instruction: Leia esta pergunta. Que informação a pessoa quer descobrir? Explique com suas palavras, sem responder à própria pergunta.

teacherOnly.illustrativeFunctionalParaphrase: Quer saber o motivo de alguém preferir o queijo fresco.
teacherOnly.nonLiteralReasonVariant: Porque o sabor suave combina com o salmão.
teacherOnly.commonConfusion: Apenas descrever o queijo, sem identificar a intenção da pergunta.

tasks.intent: identify contextual causal question function, not recite the model

en.instruction: Read this question. What is the person asking to understand? Explain in your own words without giving the dinner's actual answer.

teacherOnly.illustrativeFunctionalParaphrase: They want to learn why the people are preparing dinner together.
teacherOnly.meaningAnchor: cause of preparing the dinner together
teacherOnly.nonLiteralReasonVariant: Because cooking together gives us a chance to share the moment.
teacherOnly.commonConfusion: Describing how the food is cooked rather than what WHY asks.

es.instruction: Lee esta pregunta. ¿Qué quiere comprender quien pregunta? Explícalo con tus palabras sin dar la respuesta concreta sobre la cena.

teacherOnly.illustrativeFunctionalParaphrase: Quiere entender por qué están preparando la cena juntos.
teacherOnly.meaningAnchor: razón para preparar la cena en compañía
teacherOnly.nonLiteralReasonVariant: Porque cocinar juntos nos permite compartir ese momento.
teacherOnly.commonConfusion: Explicar cómo se prepara la cena en vez de reconocer la razón que se solicita.

pt.instruction: Leia esta pergunta. O que a pessoa está tentando compreender? Explique com suas palavras, sem dar a resposta concreta sobre o jantar.

teacherOnly.illustrativeFunctionalParaphrase: Quer compreender por que estão preparando o jantar juntos.
teacherOnly.meaningAnchor: motivo de preparar o jantar em conjunto
teacherOnly.nonLiteralReasonVariant: Porque cozinhar juntos nos permite compartilhar esse momento.
teacherOnly.commonConfusion: Explicar como o jantar é preparado, em vez de reconhecer a razão solicitada.

bands.0: Does not identify the question's function or confuses it with manner/place/object.
bands.1: Identifies a question but misses the causal information requested.
bands.2: Recognizes the topic or preference/action but causal purpose remains ambiguous.
bands.3: Identifies a reason being sought; referent is generic or partly specified.
bands.4: Clearly explains that WHY asks for the reason behind this Experience-specific preference/action in own words.

bands.0: No pertinent explanation, or contradicted contextual premise.
bands.1: Generic assertion or off-topic reason with no useful contextual support.
bands.2: Some plausible cause, but important contextual relation is unclear or incomplete.
bands.3: Coherent, relevant cause grounded in scene; slight ambiguity remains.
bands.4: Independent, context-specific, coherent and plausible causal explanation in own words; not necessarily the model's phrasing.

expressionQuality.rule: Assess meaning and grammatical clarity separately. Do not automatically reject semantically coherent paraphrases for minor spelling/inflection errors. If meaning is unclear, request review, never infer correctness.
expressionQuality.spanishAgreement: Review reference la cena → prepararla, without imposing that exact pronoun in learner's independent answer
expressionQuality.portugueseAgreement: Review reference o jantar → prepará-lo, without imposing that exact pronoun in learner's independent answer
